research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Spire Health is researching devices and methods for continuous respiratory rate monitoring, as described in a system that includes a respiration sensor configured to continuously monitor respiration data of a user. The system also features a computer-readable medium with instructions for processing this data. These efforts focus on continuous respiratory monitoring and the development of proactive feedback mechanisms for healthcare applications.
